title: Public Law 119-48: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule…
summary: H.J.Res. 104, "Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to "Miles City Field Office Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan Amendment".", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-48 on 2025-12-11, according to Congress.gov.
